sql: CREATE TABLE telemetry (event_id String, time String, source String, sourcetype String, harness String, event String) ENGINE=Memory; INSERT INTO telemetry SELECT * FROM file('<validated telemetry JSONL>', 'JSONEachRow', 'event_id String, time String, source String, sourcetype String, harness String, event String'); SELECT source, event, count() AS events FROM telemetry GROUP BY source,event ORDER BY source,event SETTINGS output_format_json_quote_64bit_integers=0
note: Mock/observed event counts are operational inputs, never independent model trials.
